scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday’s confirmed canal-history boat outing able to use readable deck narration rather than relying on improvised sightlines.
Emerging Need: A general outing possibility becomes ticketed, and the confirmation later shows the required caption-tablet listing is still absent.
Decision Context: Stored Rochester access notes identify which no-cost device request fits the boat setup and what higher-commitment requests Elias should avoid.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves an access prerequisite for the future ride; once the manifest is packed, the outing remains scheduled without that support available.

parameter.body: Thursday's 6:15 PM winter canal-history boat has remaining public seats. The guide narrates from the open aft deck, and confirmed access equipment is loaded from the dock manifest before sailing day.

parameter.subject: Reservation CHT-6741: Thursday twilight boat details
parameter.body: Your two general deck seats are confirmed for Dec. 3 at 6:15 PM. Current manifest: no accessibility equipment listed. If your party needs a deck caption device reflected on the boarding manifest, reply to access@erieharbormuseum.example before Wednesday, Dec. 2 at 3:00 PM; after that, loaner tablets are packed with the final manifest. Replies to this ticket email are also forwarded to that desk.

parameter.subject: Thursday twilight boat manifest closed
parameter.body: The Dec. 3 twilight boat manifest closed at 3:00 PM today. Reservation CHT-6741 remains listed for two general deck seats with no caption-tablet assignment, and the dock kit has already been packed for tomorrow's run. All remaining loaners have been assigned to other runs; no additional caption tablets can be loaded for this sailing.
